findings.claim: For ngd>1 in the active morphology window, a nonempty bed_update loop assigns each scalar weighted diameter to the entire local D50top/D90top arrays. The final visited local cell wins, including local halos. Different MPI ranks need not have the same value.
findings.impact: D90top reaches grain-size-dependent White-Colebrook roughness. D50top reaches local infiltration via gwnonh=1 unconnected cells and the gwnonh=0 hydrostatic path; its Reynolds effect requires the turbulence branch. D50top also enters McCall acceleration friction. Spatially uniform fractions can hide the overwrite.
findings.not_claimed: No whole-model run or quantified error; laminar infiltration is not assumed sensitive to D50top.

findings.claim: Wet erosion adds tempexchange [m] directly to infil [m/s], whereas wet accretion divides the bed-volume contribution by dt.
findings.impact: Post-step exposed infil is inconsistent. The standard next step calls gwflow, which resets and rebuilds infil before flow consumes it; a next-step continuity forcing error from this saved infil is not established.
findings.not_claimed: No correction applied; no universal mass-budget or runtime impact claim.

findings.claim: Wet groundwater-coupled morphology can change zs-zb after flow sets hh. bed_update does not assign hh; the next compute_wetcells reads it before the next flow update. wave also derives effective depths from hh.
findings.impact: For wet accretion without other changes and above the depth floor, new geometric depth is old hh - por*dzbnow. A sufficiently shallow cell can retain a wet mask inconsistent with that geometry.
findings.not_claimed: No claim that every run changes masks, that all wave modes recompute every step, or that non-groundwater dry/boundary/avalanche handling is fully covered.

findings.claim: Q3D parameter parsing and vsm_u_XB activation differ: q3d=1 or Van Rijn 1993 reads kmax and overwrites nz; flow calls vsm_u_XB only for nz>1 AND form/=FORM_VANRIJN1993. nz also has a separate input defaulting to 1.
findings.impact: Van Rijn 1993 uses its vertical concentration integration but takes the depth-averaged ue_sed/ve_sed fallback in flow. q3d=1 with kmax=1 also takes the fallback. An explicit nz>1 can reach the flow guard even with q3d=0; this alone does not establish a supported full configuration.
findings.not_claimed: The q3d label in unused local arrays does not prove an additional transport solver; no claim about other releases.

      if (par%friction_acceleration==CF_ACC_NIELSEN) then
         call acceleration_boundary_layer_effect_Nielsen(s,par)
      elseif (par%friction_acceleration==CF_ACC_MCCALL) then
         call acceleration_boundary_layer_effect(s,par)
      endif

ueuf = (1-factime)*ueuf + factime*s%ueu ! note, because taub_add has linear relation with total acceleration (dvmag/dt)
         ! the x-component taubx_add can be computed from only the u-component of the
         ! acceleration
         dudtsmooth = (ueuf-ueuold)/dtold(1)
         !dudtsmooth = (ueuf-ueuold)/dtold(1)+ududx*wetu_ududx  ! Following Baldock attempt to correct du/dt to dp/dx
         ! cut off rediculous values
         where (dudtsmooth>100*par%g)
            dudtsmooth = 100*par%g
         elsewhere (dudtsmooth<-100*par%g)
            dudtsmooth = -100*par%g
         endwhere
         s%taubx_add = s%taubx_add + par%ci*par%rho*min(s%D50top,s%hu)*dudtsmooth
      elsewhere
         ueuf = 0.d0
         veuf = 0.d0
      endwhere

else
         where(s%wetv==1)
            vevf = (1-factime)*vevf + factime*s%vev
            dvdtsmooth = (vevf-vevold)/dtold(1)
            where (dvdtsmooth>100*par%g)
               dvdtsmooth = 100*par%g
            elsewhere (dvdtsmooth<-100*par%g)
               dvdtsmooth = -100*par%g
            endwhere
            s%tauby_add = s%tauby_add + par%ci*par%rho*min(s%D50top,s%hv)*dvdtsmooth
         elsewhere
            vevf = 0.d0
